algorithm: { For each bin, assign a priority equal to the negative of the remaining capacity after adding the item if the bin can accommodate the item, otherwise assign a very low priority, such that bins with smaller remaining capacity after adding the item receive higher priority. }
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    priorities[mask] = -(bins[mask] - item)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    priorities[mask] = -np.exp(bins[mask] - item)
    return priorities

algorithm: {For each bin, if it cannot accommodate the item, set its priority to negative infinity; otherwise, assign a priority equal to the natural logarithm of one plus the maximum number of additional identical items that can fit into the bin after adding the current item, minus the reciprocal of the bin’s total capacity to avoid selecting overly large bins.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    if not np.any(mask):
        return priorities
    remaining = bins[mask] - item
    num_extra = np.floor(remaining / item)
    priorities[mask] = np.log(1 + num_extra) - 1.0 / bins[mask]
    return priorities

algorithm: {For each bin, if it cannot accommodate the item, set its priority to negative infinity; otherwise, assign a priority equal to the ratio of the bin's remaining capacity after adding the item to the size of the current item, which reflects how many additional identical items can fit into the bin afterward.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    priorities[mask] = (bins[mask] / item) - 1
    return priorities
